PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the Planning Commission on items listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.

2)
REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR A WAREHOUSE FACILITY IN AN EXISTING BUILDING LOCATED WITHIN THE INDUSTRIAL (I) ZONE PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 4501 LITTLEJOHN STREET; APPLICANT: ROBERT YEH; CASE NUMBER: CP-839). Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 16-13 "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR A WAREHOUSE FACILITY WITHIN AN EXISTING BUILDING, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 4501 LITTLEJOHN STREET; APPLICANT: ROBERT YEH; CASE NUMBER: CP-839)."
STAFF REPORT
3)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR AN AUTOMOBILE REPAIR BUSINESS, INCLUDING BODY WORK WITH ACCESSORY USED AUTOMOBILE SALES WITHIN THE IC, INDUSTRIAL COMMERCIAL ZONE (LOCATION: 14837 BADILLO ST., APN:8437-014-011; APPLICANT: JOSE ALFREDO RUIZ; CASE NO.: CP-837). Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 16-12 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW AN AUTOMOBILE REPAIR BUSINESS INCLUDING BODY WORK WITH ACCESSORY USED AUTOMOBILE SALES WITHIN THE IC, INDUSTRIAL COMMERCIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TABLE 153.050.020 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 14837 BADILLO STREET; APPLICANT: JOSE ALFREDO RUIZ; CASE NUMBER: CP-837.)"
STAFF REPORT
4)
REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A ZONE VARIANCE FROM SECTION 153.040.030.C OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE TO ALLOW A FIVE FOOT ENCROACHMENT INTO THE SIDE YARD SETBACK FOR A PROPOSED SECOND FLOOR EXPANSION/ ADDITION TO A SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCE WITHIN THE R-1, SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE. (LOCATION: 13070 FRANCISQUITO AVE; APPLICANT: HENRY SANTILLANA; CASE NO.: ZV-712). Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 16-15 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A SINGLE FAMILY, SINGLE LOT ZONE VARIANCE TO ALLOW A FIVE (5) FOOT ENCROACHMENT INTO A SECOND STORY TEN (10) FOOT SETBACK WITHIN THE R-1, SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.210, PART 8 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 13070 FRANCISQUITO AVE; APPLICANT: HENTRY SANTILLANA; CASE NUMBER: ZV-712.)"
STAFF REPORT
5)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR THE FABRICATION AND INSTALLATION OF AFTERMARKET PARTS ON AUTOMOBILES, MINOR AUTOMOBILE REPAIR, AND ACCESSORY VEHICULAR STORAGE WITHIN THE IC, INDUSTRIAL COMMERCIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE. Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 16-14 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW THE FABRICATION AND INSTALLATION OF AFTERMARKET PARTS ON AUTOMOBILES, MINOR AUTOMBILE REPAIR, AND ACCESSORY VEHCULAR STORAGE WITHIN THE IC, INDUSTRIAL COMMERCIAL ZONE PURUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE LOCATION: 15016-15020 RAMONA BOULEVARD AND 4230 ELTON AVENUE; APPLICANT: JAVIER MONTES DE OCA; CASE NUMBER: CP-838).
STAFF REPORT
6)
REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TO SUBDIVIDE FOUR LOTS INTO SIXTEEN (16) LOTS TO FACILITATE THE CONSTRUCTION OF FIFTEEN (15) SINGLE-FAMILY DETACHED RESIDENCES WITH ACCESS FROM A PRIVATE CUL-DE-SAC STREET (LOT "A") AND A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR A DENSITY BONUS TO ALLOW ONE AFFORDABLE DWELLING UNIT WITHIN THE R-1, SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLES 152.10 AND 153.040.140.A IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 4923-4929 FORTIN STREET, 15138 NUBIA STREET, AND APN 8413-013-025; APPLICANT: BALDWIN PARK HOMES, LLC; CASE NO.: CP-830, TM-73928, AND PR 15-38) Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 16-14 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK RECOMMENDING THAT THE PLANNING COMMISSION (1) APPROVE AND ADOPT THE MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT, (2) APPROVE A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW A DENSITY BONUS OF 25% OF THE ALLOWABLE DENSITY WITHIN THE R-1, SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.040.140.A OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE; (3) APPROVE A TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TO SUBDIVIDE FOUR LOTS INTO SIXTEEN LOTS FOR FIFTEEN SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DWELLING UNITS AND A LOT "A" FOR A PRIVATE CUL-DE-SAC STREET, PURSUANT TO TABLE 152.10 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE; AND (4) APPROVE A DEVELOPMENT PLAN ALLOWING THE CONSTRUCTION OF A FIFTEEN (15) UNIT SINGLE-FAMILY DETACHED RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.040.140.B OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE; (LOCATION: 4923-4929 FORTIN STREET, 15138 NUBIA STREET, AND APN 8413-013-025; APPLICANT: BALDWIN PARK HOMES, LLC; CASE NO.: CP-830, TM-73928, AND PR 15-38)."
STAFF REPORT

A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW A 27-BED ADULT RESIDENTIAL CARE FACILITY AND A PARCEL MAP TO CONSOLIDATE TWO (2) LOTS INTO ONE (1) LOT WITHIN THE R-1, SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE (LOCATION: 3562-3572 VINELAND AVENUE; APPLICANT: BRUCE ASHOORI WITH EASTERN KEYSTONE, INC.; CASE NUMBERS: CP-825 AND PM-1430). Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 16-01, consistent with the Settlement Agreement which is entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW A RESIDENTIAL CARE FACILITY AND A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TO CONSOLIDATE TWO PROPERTIES INTO ONE PROPERTY WITHIN THE R-1, SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE PURSUANT TO TABLES 153.050.020 AND 152.10 RESPECTIVELY IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 3562 VINELAND AVENUE; APPLICANT: BRUCE ASHOORI, WITH EASTERN KEYSTONE, INC.; CASE NUMBERS: CP-825 AND PM-1430)."
STAFF REPORT

MEDICAL OFFICE BUILDING AND 800 SPACE 5-STORY PARKING STRUCTURE EXPANSION TO AN EXISTING HOSPITAL/MEDICAL CENTER CAMPUS, (2) A MODIFICATION TO AN EXISTING SIGN PROGRAM TO INCLUDE THE SIGNS ASSOCIATED WITH THE PROPOSED MEDICAL OFFICE BUILDING AND PARKING STRUCTURE, AND (3) A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TO CONSOLIDATE (4) LOTS INTO (1) LOT WITHIN THE FC, FREEWAY COMMERCIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.210.130.C, SECTION 153.170.107.C AND TABLE 152.10, RESPECTIVELY IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 1011 BALDWIN PARK BLVD., 1010 LEORITA AVE. (APN'S: 8559-006-005 AND 8559-008-008, 009, AND 010) APPLICANT: SKYLER DENNISTON, REPRESENTING KAISER PERMANENTE CASE NUMBERS CP-438MOD#3; SIGN PROGRAM 13-01MOD#1; AND PM-1433). Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 16-1, entitled "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING (1) A MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT, (2) ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A MODIFICATION TO AN EXISTING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT (EXHIBIT "A") TO INCLUDE A NEW 3-STORY, 60,000 S.F. MEDICAL OFFICE BUILDING AND 5-STORY, 800+ SPACE PARKING STRUCTURE EXPANSION, PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.210.130.C IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE; (3) ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A MODIFICATION TO AN EXISTING SIGN PROGRAM TO ACCOMMODATE THE SIGNS RELATING TO THE NEW MEDICAL OFFICE BUILDING AND PARKING STRUCTURE EXPANSION, PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.170.107.C OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE; AND (4) ADOTPING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TO CONSOLIDATE FOUR (4) LOTS INTO (1) LOT TO FACILITATE THE CONSTURCTION OF A PARKING STRUCTURE EXPANSION, PURSUANT TO TABLE 152.10 ALL LOCATED WITH THE (F-C), FREEWAY COMMERCIAL ZONE, (LOCATION: 1011 BALDWIN PARK BLVD. AND 1010 LEORITA STREET (APN'S 8559-006-005 AND 8559-005-008, 009, AND 010; APPLICANT: SKYLER DENNISTON, REPRESENTING KAISER PERMANENTE; CASE NUMBERS: CP-438MOD#3, SIGN PROGRAM 13-01MOD#1, AND PM-1430)".
